name: drawer
description: A source-owned edge-anchored Drawer for Dioxus, composing the owned Dialog primitive.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the owned dialog primitive directly (DrawerTitle/DrawerDescription/Drawer re-export the Dialog primitive's parts), styled as an edge-anchored panel with a visual grab handle on Top/Bottom directions. Deliberately does not implement drag-to-dismiss (upstream shadcn's `drawer` wraps `vaul`, a real drag gesture library) -- see this file's own module doc comment and the M7 task audit (openspec/changes/build-adico-component-ecosystem/tasks.md, task 8.1) for why: a real drag gesture depends on adico-primitives' pointer.rs global pointer-position registry, a documented, unconfirmed-in-browser defect on web.
documentation.accessibility: Composes `packages/adico-primitives/src/dialog.rs` directly (the same `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal="true"`/focus-trap behavior as `Dialog`), styled as an edge-anchored panel instead of a centered modal.
documentation.keyboard: Same as `Dialog`: Escape closes it, plus the registry facade's manual backdrop `onclick` workaround for the same `use_outside_dismiss` web defect. No drag-to-dismiss gesture -- see compositionNote.
